#See some of Joshua Tree Classic’s: Cholla Garden, Skull Rock, Arch Rock, Ohlsen Ranch, and Key’s View


##Duration 
4.5 hours

##About
Only have a few short hours to spend in the park? Book a sightseeing tour with us and see the highlights of the park with an informative nature guide. Enjoy an educational shuttle around the park with plenty of amazing photo opportunities. Your shuttle driver and guide will take you around the park ensuring you don’t miss some of the best and most picturesque spots. The sightseeing tour visits Joshua Tree Classic’s including: Cholla Cactus Garden, Skull Rock, Arch Rock, Ohlsen Ranch (or Cap Rock Nature Trail), and Key’s View. Tours depart at 8am from our office in Joshua Tree. You can expect to be back around 12:30pm. Your ticket includes the park entrance fee. Advance reservations recommended. 					

##More Info
15-20% gratuity is customary.

**For groups of 8 or more please call.**
